assertions.text: transcript.md logs Gate 1 (content audit), Gate 2 (capability assessment), Gate 3 (migration verification) and Gate 4 (operator confirmation) in that order
Gates 1 and 2 precede the first CREATE, and every DELETE line is preceded by its own Gate 4 approval line
for the moved content, the CREATE line precedes the LINK line, which precedes the DELETE line
the DELETE is preceded by a recorded operator approval (Gate 4 or the step-3 consolidation approval)
final-tree.txt lists the merged reference file containing the moved content and does not list the deleted source files, and SKILL.md links to the merged file
